title: Saving a file
summary: Give your work a name and keep it.

steps.say: Click File at the top of Notepad.
steps.hint: It is the first word, top-left of the Notepad window.

steps.detail: Notice Ctrl+S on the right. That is a shortcut. You will learn it soon.
This chooses where your file will live.

steps.say: Click the File name box and type: shopping list
steps.detail: Pick a name you will remember.
Look at the top of Notepad. It now shows your file name.

steps.say: Click the X to close Notepad.
steps.detail: No question this time, because everything is saved.
